description: Checks U.S. government recall records and returns the status with the agency's own links and a signed receipt. Give `product` (a name, matched against CPSC recall titles) or `vehicle` (model year, make, model, looked up at NHTSA). Returns status recalls_found with the newest recalls (id, title, date, summary, hazard, remedy, link) or none_found; confidence says how far to trust the search (CPSC matches title words; NHTSA is exact per model). Confidence unknown when the agency's answer could not be read. Call it before advising on a used product or vehicle, or when asked whether something has been recalled.

product.description: Consumer product to check with the U.S. CPSC. Words matched against recall titles, which read like "Peloton Recalls Tread+ Treadmills", so use the brand or the product name, not both: "Tread+" or "Rock 'n Play". Fewer words match more. Give either product or vehicle, not both.

since.description: Products only: ignore CPSC recalls announced before this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Narrows the list; it does not make a slow CPSC search faster.

vehicle.description: Vehicle to check with the U.S. NHTSA by model year, make and model. Give either product or vehicle, not both.

model.description: e.g. "Camry" or "Grand Cherokee"; must be the model name as NHTSA lists it

name: check_recall
